LiteWalker has no accounts or ads. It never sells your data or sends it to LiteWalker servers. With your permission, the app writes estimated steps and distance to Health Connect. Your preferences, active workout, and five most recent workouts stay on this device, while health records remain under your control in Health Connect. You can clear recent workouts in the app, revoke permissions, or delete Health Connect records at any time.
